name: Sight
body:
The ghoul’s touch makes the subject lose its sight.

Requirement: Ghoul HD 7.

Effect: The target is blinded for 10 minutes per Hit Die the ghoul has. A successful Fortitude saving throw negates this effect.

Improved Loss

The subject becomes permanently blind on a failed saving throw. A successful saving throw leaves the subject’s eyes murky and unfocused for 1d4 rounds, leaving it able to aim its attacks towards the proper targets, but suffering a 50% miss chance on all those attacks.

Gain and Loss

If the target fails its saving throw against this effect, the ghoul’s eyes become exceptionally keen. The ghoul ignores miss chance from concealment and against invisible opponents for 10 minutes.
